description: Finished auto-mode turn handing the user a blocked `! command`, in Claude Code's layout that draws a bar down the right of every transcript row, with Claude Code's own greyed suggestion of that same command in the input box (a placeholder, not typed input). Live, this card quoted '│ ! gh pr … │' as the question and showed invented reply buttons ('Yes, proceed', 'No, cancel', 'Yes, but check with me before merging'): the handoff is not a question, and those words typed back run nothing. Pins a text user-wait with NO buttons; the bar is stripped so the prompt is the agent's sentence plus the command.
